### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/verify`, touching **58** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`, `packages/spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`  _(via evaluateCondition (symbol, a method of class AutomationEngine))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via AutomationEngine (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via AutomationEngine (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via evaluateCondition (symbol, a method of class AutomationEngine))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via AutomationEngine (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`, `packages/spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **11** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **142** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json afbf960c2649d87ff6503721b9c290ec679356c6` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `239173ff7a08ef0c4dd7167b94c38343f3fa1026` — the merge of head `05539d4230bb5487498d664af0ea563f79950f76` into base `afbf960c2649d87ff6503721b9c290ec679356c6`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 239173ff7a08ef0c4dd7167b94c38343f3fa1026 && git checkout 239173ff7a08ef0c4dd7167b94c38343f3fa1026
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin afbf960c2649d87ff6503721b9c290ec679356c6 05539d4230bb5487498d664af0ea563f79950f76 && git checkout -B drift-repro afbf960c2649d87ff6503721b9c290ec679356c6 && git merge --no-ff 05539d4230bb5487498d664af0ea563f79950f76

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json afbf960c2649d87ff6503721b9c290ec679356c6
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs afbf960c2649d87ff6503721b9c290ec679356c6` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `05539d4230bb5487498d664af0ea563f79950f76`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #19939 (body and all 76 comments; the dispatching seat's amendment `6143270685` was read as the file-surface order, never as evidence), PR #23252 (body, its one comment, the 53-row file list, the net diff `origin/main...05539d423`, merge base `01a3421f4`), the 41 check-runs on the head with every annotation, the `Check Changeset` job log, PR #23126 with card #22586 and its 13 comments (the deliberate-correction pattern and its contract review `6136739998`), `origin/main` at `4f5679c26` read-only through `git show` and `git grep`, objectui `origin/main` `866763bda` and the pinned `1fb1ced36`, and the read-only hotcrm clone at `0f84c9c`. Nothing was built, run or re-run. This record is the written confirmation `check-empty-changeset` asks for on its 15 DELIBERATE CORRECTION rows (`landing-operations.md`: a same-head at-tier PASS record is that confirmation).

### ① Derived judgments

**A. What leaves `@objectstack/service-automation`, and who could reach it.**
- `AutomationEngine.evaluateCondition` loses its template path: a bare string carrying a `{var}` hole was substituted and compared as text; it is now the CEL brace trap, refused with its source, and a `template` or `flow` envelope is refused before evaluation where it used to be taken "at the author's word". RIGHT, declared, and named with a FROM → TO. The method is public on the engine class and on `@objectstack/verify`'s `stack.automation.evaluateCondition`; it is not in `@objectstack/spec`'s contracts (`git grep evaluateCondition origin/main -- packages/spec/src/contracts/`: 0 hits). No registered flow reaches the deleted path: registration judges every structural predicate (start and edge `condition`) and every ledger-declared predicate slot (`decision` `expression`, screen `visibleWhen`) as bare CEL, where `{…}` is the #1491 brace trap (`engine.ts` `validateFlowExpressions` docblock on `origin/main`); that a `template` or `flow` envelope is refused at those same slots is the dev's 12-spelling probe (12 of 12 refused), consistent with ADR-0032 §1a and not re-run here. Callers outside this repository: objectui at the pin and at `main` call no engine `evaluateCondition` (its hits are `@object-ui/core`'s own evaluator); hotcrm's seven test call sites pass a `{ dialect: 'cel', source }` envelope or a brace-free string (`test/helpers/verify-stack.ts` wraps a string into the CEL envelope itself), and hotcrm `src` and `test` carry 0 braced conditions and 0 `template` / `flow` condition envelopes. The direct-call pins (`engine.test.ts`, `nested-region-parity.test.ts`, verify's door test) are re-pinned to the refusal; the structural shape gate (#16038) is untouched and its test file is not in the diff.
- `interpolate`, `interpolateString`, `resolveToken`, `stringifyForTemplate`, the function table and `FlowExpressionFunctionError` are deleted with four unit files. Unreachable from any published accept set: `src/index.ts` on `origin/main` exports nothing from `builtin/template.ts`, and no file outside the package imports it (`git grep "builtin/template" origin/main -- packages/` outside service-automation: 0 hits). RIGHT, no FROM → TO owed.
- `copyLiteral` replaces the two residual `interpolate()` calls (`resolveValueSlot`'s literal arm, the `assignment` executor's three shapes). For a string the judge admits the two are the identity alike: the interpolator's token regex and the value-slot judge's `TEMPLATE_TOKEN` are the same `/\{([^{}]+)\}/`, so every string the interpolator would have rewritten (a double-brace hole included, since the inner `{ x }` matches) is refused at every door first; a lone `{` or `{}` passes both unchanged. For an object the difference is the declared fix: the interpolator walked every object's own entries and wrote a `Date` as `{}`; `copyLiteral` walks plain objects and arrays only. Pinned through `registerFlow` + `execute` on the three `assignment` shapes and on `create_record` / `update_record`. RIGHT, and the stage plan's S7 item.

**B. What leaves `@objectstack/lint`.**
- `classifyFlowTemplateToken`, `FLOW_TEMPLATE_DATE_FUNCTIONS`, `FLOW_TEMPLATE_VALUE_FUNCTIONS` and the type `FlowTemplateTokenVerdict` are removed with `flow-template-grammar.ts` (whose test read `template.ts` from disk, so the deletion forces it). Consumers measured: this repository 0 outside the lint package (the only reader, `lint-flow-patterns.ts`, now asks `$User.` directly); objectui `origin/main` and the pin 0; hotcrm 0. Each is named with a FROM → TO in the changeset. RIGHT.
- `validateFlowTemplatePaths` reads double-brace holes only and skips a CRUD node's `filter` operands, so its `error` at a filter operand and every single-brace finding are gone, and `flow-template-unknown-field` / `flow-template-lookup-traversal` report `warning` only. A narrowing of findings whose replacement is named: a token at a filter operand is `expression-invalid` from the value-slot judge (`validateStackExpressions` walks `flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals` over the ledger's `filterOperands` on `origin/main`), stricter than the dropped `error`. RIGHT.
- `flow-double-brace-interpolation` and `flow-bare-dollar-reference`, at a string outside every value slot, text slot and declared literal, say the value is read as written where they prescribed a `{var}` token. RIGHT: nothing interpolates there (no executor outside the package ever imported the interpolator, and plugin nodes receive their config raw).

**C. `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/verify`, `@objectstack/formula`, docs.** Spec moves docblocks (`flow-text-slot-template.ts`, `builtin-node-config.zod.ts`, `data/context-tokens.zod.ts`, the package-internal `flow-template-token.ts`), the `FlowSchema` example's `connector_action` input (a literal; no connector-input value slot is built, as the stage plan orders), and two step-18 rationale fragments in `registry.ts.template` (the text-slot entry no longer says every other flow string keeps the dialect; the order-88 value-slot entry names every slot S1–S6 retired). No export, schema or authorable key moves; the two reference pages are regenerated and `check:docs` / `check:upgrade-guide` are green on the head. Verify: a docblock. Formula: two comments, on the module-private `isoTimestampText` and inside `registerStdLib`. `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` replaces the paragraph that still taught a `{var}` start condition; the four release-owned pages the drift check names are untouched. All RIGHT.

**D. Scope against the order.** The stage plan `6096263424`'s S7 row (resolver deletion, the engine's legacy condition path, the canon fixes; the `FlowSchema` example; the `Date` literal; `Fixes #19939`), S6's carry line `6138926915` (the three changeset corrections; the lint's single-brace filter fixtures and the bare-`$` hint's single-brace arm; the step-18 text-slot line) and the seat's amendment `6143270685` together name every one of the 53 files; nothing in the diff falls outside them, and the two things the order excludes are excluded (the #21898 carve-out is untouched; no connector-input slot is built). The carry line's closing condition holds: every position is under a judge with executor evaluation, and the resolver behind them is gone.

**E. The 15 in-place corrections, each judged on this head.** Invariants measured on all 15 between `origin/main` and the head: frontmatter bump block identical 15/15, `Clause-②` line identical 15/15, ADR-0087 marker identical 15/15 (present in 12, absent in the three patch/minor notes on both sides), no control byte, every hunk below the frontmatter. TRUE means the AFTER states this head; DROP-OK means the removed text is false on this head and nothing true went with it.
1. `19939-flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused.md:21` — "A `filter` value keeps the template dialect" dropped. DROP-OK (S6 `615c696046`: a filter operand is a value slot; this head deletes the last reader).
2. `22161-lint-slice-10-one-line.md` — title and lists drop `flow-filter-token-unknown`; 10 → 9 ids, 11 → 10; the retirement sentence added. TRUE: the rule, its exports and its `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` entry are absent on `origin/main` (`git grep flow-filter-token-unknown -- packages/lint/src packages/cli/src`: only the grammar mirror's comment, deleted here); `validateStackExpressions`, `ExprIssue` and `EXPRESSION_INVALID = 'expression-invalid'` exist. Counting the listed ids gives 9 and the `os verify` list drops the one error-severity id. The length claim (at most 194; 222 to 441) is unchanged for the nine.
3. `22161-lint-slice-14-one-line-fix.md` — 17 → 16, "10 of the 17" → "9 of the 16", the flow-filters bullet, the `flow` write bullet and the "two vocabularies" clause removed, the same retirement sentence added. TRUE by the same evidence; the "Never at the runtime gate" seven plus the nine at the door are the sixteen.
4. `19939-flow-crud-filter-operands.md:27, :43` — the retired rule gains its FROM → TO (rule id, `validateFlowFilterTokens` → `validateStackExpressions`, the finding and constant types) and the supersede sentence quoting the run-user `{uid}` row is dropped. TRUE / DROP-OK: the quoted row is corrected in its own file (item 11), which is #23126's H3 rule.
5–10. `callee-input-value-slots.md:32`, `collection-value-slots.md:38`, `http-slots.md:44`, `notify-value-slots.md:44`, `screen-value-slots.md:41`, `value-slot-date-macros-refused.md:47` — "The single-brace dialect (, date macros included,) keeps resolving where it still lives, a CRUD `filter` value." dropped. DROP-OK, false since S6.
11. `19939-flow-value-slot-run-user-refused.md:22, :30, :44` — the same sentence dropped; the `$User.Email` row reads the user record with `filter: { id: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'current_user.id' } }` (the assignment hop gone); the lint line says the hint at a node's literal, or at any other position, names the value itself. TRUE: the filter envelope is evaluated in the flow's CEL scope, which binds `current_user`; the lint's `LITERAL_HINTS` end "Write the value itself." and the new `ELSEWHERE_HINT` does too.
12. `22110-flow-text-slot-double-brace.md:24` — "a CRUD `filter` value keeps the single-brace dialect" dropped from the Unchanged line. DROP-OK.
13. `22301-verify-evaluate-condition-door.md:12` — the string is read as CEL; a `{var}` hole is refused as the brace trap and a `template` / `flow` envelope is refused too. TRUE on this head (the engine diff), and false before it, which is why it rides here.
14–15. `22502-…:33`, `22572-…:41` — "a single-brace token in a value position" dropped from the dialects a flow string speaks. DROP-OK.
Cross-reference sweep over every changeset at the head (root and `pre/`, 522 files) for each removed sentence and for the removed symbols: 0 remaining clauses quote a corrected sentence; `flow-filter-token-unknown` appears only in the S6 note and the two corrected slices; the four removed lint exports appear only in the new changeset's FROM → TO. The corrections are the #23126 shape: pending release text a later landing on the same `next` train made false (S6) or this head makes false (items 11's lint line and 13), rewritten in place, no restoration, each row naming the landing, confirmed by this record.

**F. Keeping the corrected files under `.changeset/pre/`: RIGHT.** The merge of `origin/main` brought in #21988 (`18.0.0-next.0`, merged 2026-10-13T08:04Z), whose v3 cut moved the 15 files into `.changeset/pre/`; `pre.json` is `{"mode":"pre","tag":"next"}` and tracks no list. The repository's own release tooling treats that directory as the input the next version step re-applies: `release.yml`'s post-version validation counts `.changeset/pre/*.md` as pending, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` records the v2 mechanism the move replaces (consumed notes kept "so the final release could re-apply them, and only the POST-EXIT `changeset version` deleted them"), and `check-adr-0087-registration` still judges an edited `pre/` row. So the GA `18.0.0` CHANGELOG is built from these files, and restoring them from base would print the false sentences there. The `18.0.0-next.0` entries already compiled carry the falsified text (③ item 5): released, so not this PR's to edit.

**G. The red `Check Changeset` is the designed refusal and only that.** The job log: the count step passes (1 changeset added), `check-empty-changeset` exits 1 on exactly the 15 `.changeset/pre/` rows, each a DELIBERATE CORRECTION, `check-adr-0087-registration` passes (1 declared-breaking changeset, disposition not-required / already-registered), the launch-window major guard stands aside in pre mode, and the LEVEL AXIS passes (`no (narrowing)` accounted by the two majors; spec and verify graded patch, not refused). The 10 failure annotations are the runner's per-step cap on the 15 lines. The context is not one of the required five. No other red on the head.

**H. Check-runs on `05539d423`: 41, all completed — 35 success, 5 skipped, 1 failure.** Required: `Lint & Repo Gates` success, `TypeScript Type Check` success, `Build Core` success, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success, `Test Core` success (the aggregate and all six shards). Advisory: every `Lint ·` and `Type Check ·` slice success (`Type Check · source gates` notices the ADR-0087 projection moved, as the registry edit intends), `Dogfood Regression Gate` success, `Build Docs`, `Spec property liveness`, `Check PR Size`, the five claim and single-writer guards, `Check Documentation Links` success; `Console Pin Gate`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, the dogfood shards and the packed-tarball smoke skipped by path filter; `Check Changeset` failure as in G. The PR is not governed (no `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` path), and at +867 / −2451 = 3318 changed lines it lands only on an authorized APPROVED review and the owning seat, or a human merge, as the seat's route B records; this record does not stand in for that approval.

- `.changeset/19939-flow-single-brace-resolver-deleted.md`: `@objectstack/service-automation` major (a public method narrows), `@objectstack/lint` major (four exports removed, two rules narrowed), `@objectstack/spec` patch (docblocks, an example, rationale text; no surface moves), `@objectstack/verify` patch (a docblock). ## 维护者速读(终稿)

`domain:spec` seat 2 · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H` · 2026-10-13T12:50Z · head `05539d423`。契约复审档复核 PASS:`6145835958`;席位验收 `6145940355`(在 #19939)。

**改了什么:** 这是 #19939 系列(退役流程里的单花括号模板写法 `{…}`)的收尾一步。
- 负责解析这种写法的运行时代码整段删除。
- 流程的各类条件(启动、连线、分支、屏幕显示)一律按 CEL 表达式求值。还写着 `{amount} > 100` 这类旧写法的条件会被明确拒绝,并给出正确写法。
- 顺带修好一个隐蔽缺陷:直接在代码里定义的流程,如果把日期对象写进字段值,过去会被悄悄存成空对象 `{}`,现在原样写入。
- 校验工具不再按旧写法报告问题,`@objectstack/lint` 移除 4 个只为旧写法服务的导出。
- 15 份尚未发布 GA 的版本说明里,有些句子说"旧写法在某处仍然有效",这些句子已就地改成与现状一致。
